committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 17 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test has used A$230.41 of the A$600 credit, leaving A$315.40; last 7 days spend sits at A$140.62 on 24 clicks (CPC A$5.86) with 0 conversions recorded, so cost per qualified enquiry still cannot be calculated.

Since the test started, raw paid clicks have reached 38 against 9 ask_cta_click events (the primary action), with zero review_cta_click or generate_lead. The page is now well past the 25-click mark, so headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something is broken.

AI Assistant sessions fell to 1 last 7 days from 4 prior, with chatgpt.com the only named source; remember this channel undercounts since many AI clicks land in Direct with no referrer. Organic Search is flat at 17 sessions week on week and Search Console (data only through 14 Oct, so two to three days behind yesterday) shows just 8 clicks on 237 impressions over 8 days.

Total sessions fell 14% week on week (54 vs 63 prior) and leads stayed at 0 for both periods, with calculator use also at 0 against 1 the week before. No new unverified enquiry has come through since the last brief.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the test page have reached 38, well past the 25-click freeze point: leave headline, offer and CTAs as they are unless something breaks.
Standing item: logo and image assets are still needed for the serving ad groups.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to the current site stats.
